holdout_card.fact_statement: The Storming of Ganabhaban occurred when protesters entered the Prime Minister's residence.
holdout_card.source_span: === Storming of Ganabhaban === Shortly after Sheikh Hasina's departure, at around 3:00 p.m., protesters reached the gates of the Ganabhaban and entered the Prime Minister's residence

qa_variants.question: What significant event occurred during the 2024 non-cooperation movement when protesters entered the Prime Minister's residence?
